name: Mindhammer Mushrooms

stealth.note: (trained) to notice small animal skeletons among the mushrooms

description: The mushrooms emit powerful psychic blasts that overwhelm potential predators with exhausting psychedelic visions.
disable: DC 20 Survival (trained) to navigate a safe path without triggering the mushrooms
reset: The mushrooms must rest for 24 hours before they can emit another Psychic Blast.

generalAbilities.name: Psychic Blast
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks through the mushrooms

Effect The mushrooms release a loud hum of psychic energy. The triggering creature takes (2d8+8) Mental Damage (Basic DC 23 Will Saving Throw). On a critical failure, the creature is Fatigued.
